```python
import sqlite3
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from pathlib import Path

# 设置工作路径
work_path = Path('⟨workdir⟩')
db_path = work_path / 'dacomp-072.sqlite'

# 连接数据库
conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)

# 查看数据库中的表
tables_query = "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table';"
tables = pd.read_sql_query(tables_query, conn)
print("数据库中的表:")
print(tables)

# 查看lever__hiring_manager_scorecard表结构
scorecard_query = "PRAGMA table_info(lever__hiring_manager_scorecard);"
scorecard_info = pd.read_sql_query(scorecard_query, conn)
print("\nlever__hiring_manager_scorecard表结构:")
print(scorecard_info)

# 读取数据（注意：根据政策，不显示机密字段的行级数据）
# 只读取需要的字段，不包含机密字段
data_query = """
SELECT 
    performance_tier,
    hiring_specialization, 
    decision_speed_category,
    overall_performance_score
FROM lever__hiring_manager_scorecard
WHERE overall_performance_score IS NOT NULL
"""

data = pd.read_sql_query(data_query, conn)
conn.close()

print(f"\n数据形状: {data.shape}")
print("\n数据前5行:")
print(data.head())
print("\n数据基本信息:")
print(data.info())
print("\n各字段唯一值数量:")
for col in data.columns:
    if col != 'overall_performance_score':
        unique_vals = data[col].nunique()
        print(f"{col}: {unique_vals}个唯一值")

# 检查是否有缺失值
print("\n缺失值检查:")
print(data.isnull().sum())

# 计算总体平均分数
overall_mean = data['overall_performance_score'].mean()
print(f"\n总体平均性能分数: {overall_mean:.4f}")

# 计算每个维度分组的边际贡献
def calculate_marginal_contribution(data, dimension):
    """
    计算指定维度的边际贡献
    边际贡献 = 总体平均 - 排除该分组后的总体平均
    """
    marginal_results = {}
    overall_mean = data['overall_performance_score'].mean()
    
    # 获取该维度的所有唯一值（排除缺失值）
    unique_values = data[dimension].dropna().unique()
    
    for value in unique_values:
        # 排除当前分组的数据
        excluded_data = data[data[dimension] != value]
        
        # 检查剩余数据是否满足最小数量要求（≥5条记录）
        if len(excluded_data) >= 5:
            excluded_mean = excluded_data['overall_performance_score'].mean()
            marginal_contribution = overall_mean - excluded_mean
            marginal_results[value] = {
                'marginal_contribution': marginal_contribution,
                'group_count': len(data[data[dimension] == value]),
                'excluded_count': len(excluded_data)
            }
        else:
            marginal_results[value] = {
                'marginal_contribution': np.nan,
                'group_count': len(data[data[dimension] == value]),
                'excluded_count': len(excluded_data),
                'note': '<5 (suppressed)'
            }
    
    return pd.DataFrame(marginal_results).T

# 计算三个维度的边际贡献
print("\n=== 计算边际贡献 ===")

# performance_tier维度
print("\n1. performance_tier维度的边际贡献:")
tier_contrib = calculate_marginal_contribution(data, 'performance_tier')
tier_contrib_sorted = tier_contrib.sort_values('marginal_contribution', ascending=False)
print(tier_contrib_sorted)

# hiring_specialization维度
print("\n2. hiring_specialization维度的边际贡献:")
specialization_contrib = calculate_marginal_contribution(data, 'hiring_specialization')
specialization_contrib_sorted = specialization_contrib.sort_values('marginal_contribution', ascending=False)
print(specialization_contrib_sorted)

# decision_speed_category维度
print("\n3. decision_speed_category维度的边际贡献:")
speed_contrib = calculate_marginal_contribution(data, 'decision_speed_category')
speed_contrib_sorted = speed_contrib.sort_values('marginal_contribution', ascending=False)
print(speed_contrib_sorted)

# 创建可视化图表
plt.figure(figsize=(15, 10))

# 1. performance_tier边际贡献图
plt.subplot(2, 2, 1)
valid_tier = tier_contrib_sorted[tier_contrib_sorted['marginal_contribution'].notna()]
plt.bar(valid_tier.index, valid_tier['marginal_contribution'])
plt.title('Performance Tier Marginal Contribution')
plt.xlabel('Performance Tier')
plt.ylabel('Marginal Contribution')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. hiring_specialization边际贡献图
plt.subplot(2, 2, 2)
valid_spec = specialization_contrib_sorted[specialization_contrib_sorted['marginal_contribution'].notna()]
plt.bar(valid_spec.index, valid_spec['marginal_contribution'])
plt.title('Hiring Specialization Marginal Contribution')
plt.xlabel('Hiring Specialization')
plt.ylabel('Marginal Contribution')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. decision_speed_category边际贡献图
plt.subplot(2, 2, 3)
valid_speed = speed_contrib_sorted[speed_contrib_sorted['marginal_contribution'].notna()]
plt.bar(valid_speed.index, valid_speed['marginal_contribution'])
plt.title('Decision Speed Category Marginal Contribution')
plt.xlabel('Decision Speed Category')
plt.ylabel('Marginal Contribution')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 4. 总体性能分数分布
plt.subplot(2, 2, 4)
plt.hist(data['overall_performance_score'], bins=20, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
plt.axvline(x=overall_mean, color='red', linestyle='--', label=f'总体平均: {overall_mean:.2f}')
plt.title('Overall Performance Score Distribution')
plt.xlabel('Performance Score')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(work_path / 'marginal_contribution_analysis.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

# 保存结果到CSV文件
tier_contrib_sorted.to_csv(work_path / 'performance_tier_marginal_contributions.csv')
specialization_contrib_sorted.to_csv(work_path / 'hiring_specialization_marginal_contributions.csv')
speed_contrib_sorted.to_csv(work_path / 'decision_speed_category_marginal_contributions.csv')

print("\n=== 总结报告 ===")
print(f"总体平均性能分数: {overall_mean:.4f}")
print(f"总记录数: {len(data)}")

# 找出每个维度中边际贡献最高的组
print("\n各维度边际贡献最高的组:")

# performance_tier
if not valid_tier.empty:
    top_tier = valid_tier.iloc[0]
    print(f"Performance Tier - 最高边际贡献: {top_tier.name} (贡献度: {top_tier['marginal_contribution']:.4f})")

# hiring_specialization
if not valid_spec.empty:
    top_spec = valid_spec.iloc[0]
    print(f"Hiring Specialization - 最高边际贡献: {top_spec.name} (贡献度: {top_spec['marginal_contribution']:.4f})")

# decision_speed_category
if not valid_speed.empty:
    top_speed = valid_speed.iloc[0]
    print(f"Decision Speed Category - 最高边际贡献: {top_speed.name} (贡献度: {top_speed['marginal_contribution']:.4f})")

print("\n分析完成！结果已保存到:")
print(f"1. 图表: {work_path / 'marginal_contribution_analysis.png'}")
print(f"2. performance_tier结果: {work_path / 'performance_tier_marginal_contributions.csv'}")
print(f"3. hiring_specialization结果: {work_path / 'hiring_specialization_marginal_contributions.csv'}")
print(f"4. decision_speed_category结果: {work_path / 'decision_speed_category_marginal_contributions.csv'}")
```

import sqlite3
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from pathlib import Path

# 设置工作路径
work_path = Path('⟨workdir⟩')

for col in data.columns:

# 检查是否有缺失值
print("\n缺失值检查:")
print(data.isnull().sum())

# 计算总体平均分数
overall_mean = data['overall_performance_score'].mean()
print(f"\n总体平均性能分数: {overall_mean:.4f}")

# 计算每个维度分组的边际贡献
def calculate_marginal_contribution(data, dimension):
    """
    计算指定维度的边际贡献
    边际贡献 = 总体平均 - 排除该分组后的总体平均
    """
    marginal_results = {}
    overall_mean = data['overall_performance_score'].mean()
    
    # 获取该维度的所有唯一值（排除缺失值）
    unique_values = data[dimension].dropna().unique()
    
    for value in unique_values:
        # 排除当前分组的数据
        excluded_data = data[data[dimension] != value]
        
        # 检查剩余数据是否满足最小数量要求（≥5条记录）
        if len(excluded_data) >= 5:
            excluded_mean = excluded_data['overall_performance_score'].mean()
            marginal_contribution = overall_mean - excluded_mean
            marginal_results[value] = {
                'marginal_contribution': marginal_contribution,
                'group_count': len(data[data[dimension] == value]),
                'excluded_count': len(excluded_data)
            }
        else:
            marginal_results[value] = {
                'marginal_contribution': np.nan,
                'group_count': len(data[data[dimension] == value]),
                'excluded_count': len(excluded_data),
                'note': '<5 (suppressed)'
            }
    
    return pd.DataFrame(marginal_results).T

# 计算三个维度的边际贡献

print(tier_contrib_sorted)

# hiring_specialization维度
print("\n2. hiring_specialization维度的边际贡献:")
specialization_contrib = calculate_marginal_contribution(data, 'hiring_specialization')

speed_contrib_sorted = speed_contrib.sort_values('marginal_contribution', ascending=False)
print(speed_contrib_sorted)
